notes:
Pass on the fake backend. The package serves the first confirmed card entry symbol, the XArm6Reach-v3 environment (uf_gym.envs.uf_tasks.xarm6_tasks:XArm6ReachEnv); the other card symbols (XArm7PickAndPlaceEnv, XArm6, XArm7) are named in facts.md and are not bound. The card's mock_strategy preferred upstream-sim could not be run: the upstream environment needs gymnasium, pybullet and panda-gym (README.md:11-12) and a sibling panda-gym checkout (test_xarm6_reach.py:3), and package code never imports the clone, so fake.py is a pure Python kinematic stand-in. The gate never ran the sim backend (gymnasium.make('XArm6Reach-v3')), and no hardware was attached or run. The fake reproduces the clone's action space Box(-1, 1, shape=(3,)) (uf_gym/envs/uf_robots/xarm6.py:32-34), the 0.05 m action scale (xarm6.py:85), the z>=0 clip (xarm6.py:90) and the 50-step limit (uf_gym/__init__.py:19); its goal, reward, success radius, start position and observation values are marked # placeholder in fake.py and are not facts. Fidelity is F0 with timestep_ms 0 because neither the clone nor the fake states the PyBullet physics timestep; the gaps say there is no rigid-body dynamics, contact or actuator model, no wall-clock pacing, a flat placeholder observation, a placeholder reward and no hardware validation. NOT COVERED: the upstream panda-gym observation dict and its Reach reward computation, and the upstream PyBullet rigid-body dynamics; the fake returns a flat placeholder observation vector and a placeholder reward. Expected warnings and why: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the next reset, so it makes no native call); G7.MAYBE_ABSENT x4 for action_space, reset, step and close because XArm6ReachEnv inherits them from the external panda-gym RobotTaskEnv, which the clone does not define; G8.NO_UNIT x4 for the bridge-derived ticks, seed (twice) and action.values inputs. There is no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning. The upstream clone was not modified and no upstream code was imported, installed or run.
